newsitem.title: UK: Courtaulds says to sell underwear unit.
newsitem.headline: Courtaulds says to sell underwear unit.

text.p: Courtaulds Textiles said on Wednesday it was planning to sell its licensed Jockey underwear business to a subsidiary of Jockey International Inc for the value of its net assets as at December 31, 1996.
The net assets, excluding borrowings, stood at 1.6 million as at December 31, 1995.
The unit for sale has been supplying men's and women's branded underwear in the UK and Scandinavia.
"This sale is being made as part of Courtaulds Textiles' prgramme to concentrate its resources on leading positions in chosen markets," the firm said in a statment.
The business comprised a manufacturing facility at Gateshead and included sales, marketing and administration functions.
The purchaser, Jockey International, owns the brand names Jockey, Jockey for Her and Y-Front.
